# Gesture fixtures

`gesture-animation.webp` is a synthetic 480 × 480 moving square on a cream
background. It has four frames with three positions, 300 ms per frame and infinite looping.
`gesture-static.png` is its first frame. Neither file is a hand signal or approved
product artwork.

The offline suite copies these files into its temporary production builds to
exercise optional rhythm gestures, animation rendering, responsive headers,
localized previews, touch and keyboard controls, and precaching. They are never
copied into the production site's public directory.
